description: Searches Hire Overseas's pool of remote professionals in the Philippines, Latin America and Africa for a role and returns up to 5 candidate profiles in seconds. Profile text is redacted and pseudonymous: first name, country, skills and experience; never a surname, contact detail or employer name. Each profile has a candidateRef that get_candidate_resume and request_intro accept, and says whether a resume exists. A profile can also have an intro video link, which is not redacted and may identify the person by face and voice. For closer matches pass the full job description (job_description or job_description_url) or a brief. When the role is described in only a few words the answer also carries clarifyingQuestions: ask the user them and search again with the answers.

brief.description: Structured requirements, e.g. from scope_role or the user's answers to clarifyingQuestions: {mustHaveSkills, niceToHaveSkills, minYearsExperience, regions, budgetMonthlyUsd, hoursPerWeek, timezone, industry}.

description.description: What the person will do, tools they need, hours. More detail gives better matches.

job_description.description: The full job description as text, if the user has one (up to 20,000 characters).

job_description_url.description: An https link to the job description (a job post, PDF or Word file). Hire Overseas fetches and reads it.

lead_token.description: leadToken from verify_email, if the user verified their email. Enables a closer reranking.

minYearsExperience.description: Only return candidates with at least this many years of relevant experience, e.g. 3

regions.description: Limit to regions: ph (Philippines), latam (Latin America), africa. Omit for all.

name: search_candidates
title: Search overseas candidates
